findings.claim: Gartner predicts that by 2026, 40% of enterprise applications will include task-specific AI agents.
findings.issue: Directionally correct but loses precision. Gartner's actual claim is '40% of enterprise applications will be integrated with task-specific AI agents by the END of 2026, up from less than 5% in 2025.' Consider adding 'by end of 2026' and the '<5% baseline' for accuracy; not blocking.
